Norwich City attempted to control the tempo through sustained possession, but they found it difficult to break through a well-organized Osasuna backline. Second Half Breakthrough and Immediate Response The deadlock was finally broken in the 60th minute as the intensity shifted. Norwich City ’s H. The advantage, however, was short-lived as the visitors from Spain refused to back down, immediately ramping up their offensive pressure to find a way back into the game. Just seven minutes later, in the 67th minute, Osasuna found their equalizer. R. García displayed great composure to find the back of the net, drawing the scores level at 1-1. The goal shifted the momentum back toward the visitors, though the match remained a balanced contest heading into the closing stages. Late Drama Seals the Result As the clock ticked into stoppage time, the game delivered a final, dramatic twist. In the 90+2 minute, with the match seemingly destined for a draw, A. It was a classic pre-season finale that provided plenty of talking points for both coaching staffs.

The first half was a cagey affair, with both teams prioritizing defensive organization over all-out attack. While there were occasional chances and bursts of pace, neither goalkeeper was truly tested during the opening 45 minutes as the tactical battle took center stage in this prestigious friendly match . The goal forced AC Milan to take more risks and push higher up the pitch as they searched for a way back into the contest. Christopher Nkunku stepped up under immense pressure and coolly converted the spot-kick to level the score at 1-1. The stage was set for an intriguing encounter as Fulham and Newcastle faced off in a high-profile pre-season friendly. With the 2026-07-26 match date marked on the calendar, 27,442 fans packed the stands to witness both sides refine their strategies ahead of the upcoming campaign. Diop Breaks the Deadlock The contest began with a cagey opening as both teams sought to establish dominance in midfield. However, it was Fulham who struck first in the 20th minute. Following a well-worked attacking sequence, Issa Diop rose highest in the box to power a commanding header into the back of the net. The early goal gave the Cottagers a deserved lead and forced Newcastle to become more adventurous in their approach. As the first half progressed, Newcastle looked to respond through set-pieces delivered by Lewis Hall and Bruno Guimarães , but the Fulham backline remained resolute. Rodrigo Muniz nearly doubled the advantage in the 28th minute with a sharp header of his own, only to be denied by a comfortable save from Nick Pope . The visitors struggled to find their clinical edge, leaving the score at 1-0 as the teams headed into the break. Cairney’s Moment of Magic The second half saw a flurry of tactical changes and an increase in physical intensity. Newcastle 's Bruno Guimarães and Yoane Wissa both saw yellow as the referee worked to maintain control. The decisive moment arrived in the 80th minute, courtesy of a brilliant substitution. Harry Wilson , having recently entered the fray, played a short corner to Tom Cairney . The experienced midfielder unleashed a stunning left-footed strike from outside the box that flew past Nick Pope to make it 2-0. In the closing stages, Newcastle pushed forward in search of a late lifeline, with Sean Neave seeing a shot blocked by a determined Jorge Cuenca . Despite a missed chance by Alex Iwobi and late bookings for Antonee Robinson and Cuenca , Fulham managed the game professionally. The final whistle confirmed a solid 2-0 victory for the London side, providing a significant boost of confidence as they continue their pre-season preparations.

Both sides used the occasion to test their tactical depth in a match that remained unpredictable until the final whistle. Breaking the Deadlock After a tightly contested first half where chances were at a premium, the game roared to life shortly after the restart. In the 50th minute, T. Civeja found the breakthrough for Karlsruher SC , firing his side into a 1-0 lead. The goal shifted the momentum in favor of the hosts, who began to play with increased confidence, while Inter was forced to chase the game and search for a creative spark in the final third. As the second half progressed, the physical nature of the contest intensified. T. Civeja , the opening goalscorer, found himself in the referee's book in the 70th minute, receiving a yellow card as Karlsruher SC fought hard to preserve their advantage. It appeared for a long time that the German side would hold on for a narrow victory, as they successfully frustrated the Italian giants' attacking maneuvers. Diouf’s Stoppage-Time Brilliance Just as the match entered its final moments, the narrative took a stunning turn in favor of the visitors. In the first minute of stoppage time (90+1'), A. Diouf found the back of the net to equalize for Inter , silencing the home crowd. The late goal injected a sudden burst of energy into the Nerazzurri, who refused to settle for a draw. In a breathtaking conclusion to the match, A. Diouf struck again in the 90+4th minute, completing a sensational personal brace and securing a 1-2 victory for Inter . The dramatic turnaround left Karlsruher SC stunned, as they saw a potential win evaporate in the space of just three minutes. For Inter , it was a testament to their "never say die" attitude, turning a looming defeat into a morale-boosting triumph.
